592:t_1:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Come now, don't make such a scary face. It's not like we're strangers.」

592:t_1:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「The $$西条涼音$$ I know is not a woman like you.」

592:t_1:8.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「If we're talking about that, the $$リディ・マーセナス$$ who remains in my memory was a far better man than you.」

592:t_1:10.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Well, let's not go there. We've both ended up siding with $$サイデリアル$$.」

592:t_1:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「I have no intention of wagging my tail for them.」

592:t_1:12.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's the same thing. Whether it's $$クロノ$$ or $$サイデリアル$$.」

592:t_1:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「Do you know? The true doctrine of $$クロノ$$... The truth that lies even deeper than $$ラプラスの箱$$?」

592:t_1:14.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Vaguely. I'm not a Reactor candidate just for show.」

592:t_1:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「Is your goal to defeat $n and get the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$?」

592:t_1:16.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I can't leave it to $$バルビエル$$. If you want something, you should get it with your own strength, after all.」

592:t_1:19.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm after $n, you're after $$バナージ$$... and it's $c we're both going after.」

592:t_1:20.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「As for where they are, we can pinpoint it by combining the tracking data with the resonance between me and $n.」

592:t_1:21.en:
$$リディ$$
「...What do you wish for by getting the $$スフィア$$?」

592:t_1:22.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Freedom. If you have power, you can have it.」

592:t_1:23.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「No one can bind me. That's right... not even a me that isn't me.」

592:t_1:25.en:
$$リディ$$
「Something like that is a sham...」

592:t_1:26.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So that's your reason for fighting.」

592:t_1:27.en:
$$リディ$$
「Both I and humanity can only live within the freedom we've been given... That is our destiny...」

592:t_1:31.en: ～ Outer-Space Mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ Bridge ～

592:t_1:32.en:
$$クィーン$$
「You seem to have been quite active.」

592:t_1:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「As you know. We've fought across spacetime, straddling parallel worlds.」

592:t_1:34.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Even I have no grasp of what happened after you were swallowed by the $$時空震動$$.」

592:t_1:35.en:
$$クィーン$$
「For now, thanks to the flashy moves you've been making on every front, the Empire's battle lines are falling into disarray.」

592:t_1:36.en:
$$シャア$$
「The time for the decisive battle is drawing near.」

592:t_1:37.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Naturally, the Empire's side can sense it too.」

592:t_1:38.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our aim is to take $$ラース・バビロン$$, the core of the enemy's strategy, and free the people imprisoned in the $$霊子吸収システム$$.」

592:t_1:39.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And if we overthrow $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ and defeat the three Reactors who serve as executives, we could tilt the war situation completely toward Earth's side.」

592:t_1:40.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That's right. If you defeat those four, you could say the Empire has been overthrown.」

592:t_1:41.en:
$$クィーン$$
「But, naturally, the Earthlings who surrendered to the Empire have started to move in order to stop you.」

592:t_1:42.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$クロノ$$... and $$ネオ・ジオン$$, then.」

592:t_1:43.en:
$$オットー$$
「Both of them are vying for the seat of $$サイデリアル$$'s number-one underling, so it would be fine if they just turned on each other, but...」

592:t_1:44.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I doubt it will go that way. The cunning $$フル・フロンタル$$ in particular is waiting to snatch the spoils while the others fight.」

592:t_1:45.en:
$$シャア$$
「He's going after $$ラプラスの箱$$ as proof of his own power?」

592:t_1:46.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Conversely, if you get the Box, that would stop $$フロンタル$$'s plan.」

592:t_1:47.en:
$$桂$$
「Is that how you plan to stir up a decisive battle between us and $$ネオ・ジオン$$?」

592:t_1:48.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I thought you went out of your way to sit in on this meeting, and now you're awfully combative, $$始原の特異点$$.」

592:t_1:49.en:
$$桂$$
「I believe you're the one who came at me first.」

592:t_1:50.en:
$$桂$$
「I've had enough of your provocative attitude.」

592:t_1:52.en:
$$クィーン$$
「It's all right. What he says is true, too.」

592:t_1:53.en:
$$桂$$
「...But I don't want to keep things on bad terms with a lady, either.」

592:t_1:54.en:
$$桂$$
「How about it, $$クィーン$$? Isn't it about time you showed your true face?」

592:t_1:55.en:
$$クィーン$$
「As a come-on, that's a little too straightforward.」

592:t_1:56.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm not saying unconditionally. ...What if we defeat the Empire?」

592:t_1:57.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I might think about it.」

592:t_1:59.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That positive streak is your strong point.」

592:t_1:60.en:
$$桂$$
「It's not only me. It's what's good about everyone in $c.」

592:t_1:61.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I wonder what will happen when you people open $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

592:t_1:62.en:
$$シャア$$
「The way you talk... You seem to know what lies at the very bottom of the so-called $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

592:t_1:64.en:
$$桂$$
「As expected. Even if you call yourself the third $$クロノ$$, you're still $$クロノ$$.」

592:t_1:65.en:
$$クィーン$$
「It's true that the secret of $$ラプラスの箱$$ is $$クロノ$$'s doctrine, but only a very small part of the executives are told all of it.」

592:t_1:66.en:
$$クィーン$$
「In my case, I made use of my special position as the $$キング$$'s secretary.」

592:t_1:67.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$キング$$... So he's the supreme head of the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives.」

592:t_1:68.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Is that information network of yours built on the connections from your time in $$クロノ$$?」

592:t_1:69.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I won't deny that. But that's not all my collaborators are.」

592:t_1:70.en:
$$クィーン$$
「There are many people who hold a grudge against the Empire. To be precise, it isn't the Empire itself, though...」

592:t_1:71.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Some of them even have influence reaching the heart of the Empire. Handing the 'Spear' to $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ was that person's doing.」

592:t_1:72.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The Evangelion Spear, which has the power to warp spacetime...」

592:t_1:73.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So the route by which $$レナード$$ obtained it was an informant.」

592:t_1:74.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So the Empire isn't monolithic either.」

592:t_1:75.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Still, all we can do is leak information like this, and in the end we're still counting on you.」

592:t_1:76.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Heh... I'm looking forward to it. The day you touch the truth of the Box... and the day you challenge the Empire to the decisive battle.」

592:t_1:77.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I'm waiting, too, for the day I can meet you with my true face.」

592:t_1:79.en:
$$桂$$
「Not necessarily. Her heart is turned toward me...」

592:t_1:80.en:
$$桂$$
「I'd say she doesn't really mind showing her true face, either.」

592:t_1:81.en:
$$テッサ$$
「As one would expect from someone rumored to be a veteran of a hundred battles when it comes to women's hearts.」

592:t_1:82.en:
$$桂$$
「I guess so. Besides, she's interested in me. Drawing out her true feelings isn't that hard.」

592:t_1:83.en:
$$オットー$$
「I don't quite follow, but it seems our attempt to bring you to this meeting was a success.」

592:t_1:84.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Well then, first let's concentrate on intercepting the $$クロノ$$ forces heading this way.」

592:t_1:85.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As far as they're concerned, having $$ラプラスの箱$$ seized by $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is a situation to avoid at all costs.」

kept_omissions: 592:t_1:20: 奴等 kept as 'they' (assumed to be the $c squad targeted in row 19; Ambriel/Riddhe both mean Hibiki's group).
592:t_1:16: subject of 欲しいものは...手に入れるべき kept general ('you'); reads as a maxim aimed at Riddhe.
uncertain: 592:t_1:19: '$c' rendered as the shared target ('we're both going after $c'); 共に狙う is read as both going after the squad.
592:t_1:64: 第３のクロノ rendered 'the third Chrono' (Queen's own faction-less self label), Kei addressing Queen directly as 'you'.
592:t_1:71: 『槍』 rendered 'the 'Spear'' (capital S as in dlg_2081_02); そいつ kept gender-neutral ('that person').
592:t_1:31: caption uses 'Outer-Space Mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$' (matches dlg_2047_01); 592:t_1:3 'Chrono Ship Bridge' (クロノ艦 has no glossary entry).
592:t_1:27: 宿命 = 'destiny' (stage title 'Beyond Destiny'); earlier slices are mixed fate/destiny.
592:t_1:8/7: Ambriel here is Suzune's hidden personality speaking through the Suzune portrait; Riddhe's 西条涼音 line uses the full token.
